# Worldedge audio credits

Every sound in this folder is cut from a field or foley recording that its author released into the public domain.
No attribution is required for any of them; the authors are credited here with thanks.
`tools/worldedge-audio.json` holds the exact excerpt and processing of each file, and `tools/place-audio.py --set worldedge` rebuilds them.

## Files

- `brink.mp3` is cut from "At the Top of a Large Waterfall" by ProductionNow, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/ProductionNow/sounds/352902/.
- `roar.mp3` is cut from "NIAGARA WATERS ROARING.mp3" by KevinT1001, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/KevinT1001/sounds/379905/.
- `rapids.mp3` is cut from "NF_CanadianRapids#01" by YevgVerh, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/YevgVerh/sounds/747840/.
